The weighted cloud reliability calculator successfully passed all tests with a perfect verifier reward, demonstrating a functional core logic implementation.
The execution achieved a 1.000 mean reward across 1 trial with zero exceptions recorded. The pytest suite in 'test_output.py' passed 100% of tests (1/1) in 0.47 seconds using pytest version 8.4.1. While the verifier reward was 1.0, the judge reward of 0.68 suggests potential for improvement in code style, documentation, or edge-case handling beyond the primary success path.
